# Sound Task Accuracy correlation with Elision
```{r load-data}
# ---- Read data ----
# UPDATE the file path to your workbook
file <- "/Users/avantika/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/BDL/Member_Folders/Avantika/000_Projects/P_004_ELP_DLD/DataAnalysis/matched_pairs_phon_sem.xlsx"
sheet <- "Matched_phon"
dat_phon <- openxlsx::read.xlsx(file, sheet = sheet, detectDates = FALSE)

# ---- Normality Test on All 4 Variables ----

# Define all 4 variables
vars <- list(
  Phon_Task_Accuracy_DLD = dat_phon$Phon_Task_Accuracy_DLD,
  CTOPP2_EL_ScS_DLD     = dat_phon$`CTOPP-2_EL_ScS_DLD`,
  Phon_Task_Accuracy_TYP = dat_phon$Phon_Task_Accuracy_TYP,
  CTOPP2_EL_ScS_TYP     = dat_phon$`CTOPP-2_EL_ScS_TYP`
)

# ---- Shapiro-Wilk Normality Test ----
cat("===== SHAPIRO-WILK NORMALITY TEST =====\n\n")

normality_results <- data.frame()

for (var_name in names(vars)) {
  # Convert to numeric if not already
  variable_data <- as.numeric(vars[[var_name]])
  # Remove NA values
  variable_data <- variable_data[!is.na(variable_data)]
  
  test <- shapiro.test(vars[[var_name]])
  normality_results <- rbind(normality_results, data.frame(
    Variable    = var_name,
    W_statistic = round(test$statistic, 4),
    p_value     = round(test$p.value, 4),
    Normal      = ifelse(test$p.value > 0.05, "Yes", "No")
  ))
}

print(normality_results, row.names = FALSE)

# ---- Q-Q Plots for All 4 Variables ----
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
for (var_name in names(vars)) {
  qqnorm(vars[[var_name]], 
         main = paste("Q-Q Plot:", var_name),
         col  = "steelblue", pch = 19)
  qqline(vars[[var_name]], col = "red", lwd = 2)
}
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

cat("\nInterpretation: p-value > 0.05 = Normal | p-value < 0.05 = Not Normal\n")

# ---- Decision Logic: Pearson vs Spearman ----

# Extract p-values for decision-making
phon_dld_normal <- normality_results$p_value[normality_results$Variable == "Phon_Task_Accuracy_DLD"] > 0.05
ctopp_dld_normal <- normality_results$p_value[normality_results$Variable == "CTOPP2_EL_ScS_DLD"] > 0.05

phon_typ_normal <- normality_results$p_value[normality_results$Variable == "Phon_Task_Accuracy_TYP"] > 0.05
ctopp_typ_normal <- normality_results$p_value[normality_results$Variable == "CTOPP2_EL_ScS_TYP"] > 0.05

# Determine appropriate test for each pair
cat("\n===== CORRELATION TEST SELECTION =====\n\n")

# Pair 1: DLD group
pair1_test <- ifelse(phon_dld_normal & ctopp_dld_normal, "Pearson", "Spearman")
cat("Pair 1 (DLD): Phon_Task_Accuracy_DLD vs CTOPP2_EL_ScS_DLD\n")
cat("  → Both Normal?", phon_dld_normal & ctopp_dld_normal, "\n")
cat("  → Use:", pair1_test, "correlation\n\n")

# Pair 2: TYP group
pair2_test <- ifelse(phon_typ_normal & ctopp_typ_normal, "Pearson", "Spearman")
cat("Pair 2 (TYP): Phon_Task_Accuracy_TYP vs CTOPP2_EL_ScS_TYP\n")
cat("  → Both Normal?", phon_typ_normal & ctopp_typ_normal, "\n")
cat("  → Use:", pair2_test, "correlation\n\n")

# ---- Run Correlation Tests ----
cat("===== CORRELATION RESULTS =====\n\n")

# Pair 1: DLD
#cat("DLD GROUP:\n")
cor_dld <- cor.test(dat_phon$Phon_Task_Accuracy_DLD, 
                    dat_phon$`CTOPP-2_EL_ScS_DLD`,
                    method = tolower(pair1_test))
print(cor_dld)

# Pair 2: TYP

cor_typ <- cor.test(dat_phon$Phon_Task_Accuracy_TYP, 
                    dat_phon$`CTOPP-2_EL_ScS_TYP`,
                    method = tolower(pair2_test))
print(cor_typ)

# ---- Summary Table ----
cat("\n\n===== SUMMARY TABLE =====\n\n")
summary_table <- data.frame(
  Group = c("DLD", "TYP"),
  Test = c(pair1_test, pair2_test),
  Correlation = c(round(cor_dld$estimate, 4), round(cor_typ$estimate, 4)),
  P_value = c(round(cor_dld$p.value, 4), round(cor_typ$p.value, 4)),
  Significant = c(ifelse(cor_dld$p.value < 0.05, "Yes", "No"),
                  ifelse(cor_typ$p.value < 0.05, "Yes", "No"))
)
print(summary_table, row.names = FALSE)

```
# Plot Sound Task Accuracy vs Elision Score
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

# Prepare data in long format for overlay plot
dat_plot <- data.frame(
  Group = c(rep("DLD", length(dat_phon$Phon_Task_Accuracy_DLD)),
            rep("TYP", length(dat_phon$Phon_Task_Accuracy_TYP))),
  Phonology = c(dat_phon$Phon_Task_Accuracy_DLD, 
                dat_phon$Phon_Task_Accuracy_TYP),
  CTOPP = c(dat_phon$`CTOPP-2_EL_ScS_DLD`, 
            dat_phon$`CTOPP-2_EL_ScS_TYP`)
)
# ============================================================
# Create overlay plot regression plot
# ============================================================

p <- ggplot(dat_plot, aes(x = Phonology, y = CTOPP, color = Group, fill = Group)) +
  # Scatter points
  geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.7, shape = 21, color = "black", stroke = 0.5) +
  # Trend lines with confidence intervals
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, alpha = 0.15, linewidth = 1.2, show.legend = FALSE) +
  # Labels and title
  labs(
    #title = "Correlation: Phonology Task vs CTOPP-2 Elision",
    #subtitle = "DLD vs Typical Development Groups",
    x = "Sound Task Accuracy (%)",
    y = "Elision (CTOPP-2)",
    color = "Group",
    fill = "Group"
  ) +
  # Styling
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "gray40", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    # Tick labels: SIZE 14 and BLACK
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, color = "black"),
    
  # Legend OUTSIDE
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    #legend.key.size = unit(1, "cm"),
    #legend.background = element_rect(color = "black", fill = "white", size = 1),
    #legend.box.margin = margin(t = 8, r = 8, b = 8, l = 8),
    
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, size = 0.7)
  ) +
  
  # Color scheme
  scale_color_manual(values = c("DLD" = "#66c2a5", "TYP" = "#fc8d62")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("DLD" = "#66c2a5", "TYP" = "#fc8d62")) +
  
# Axis scales
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 20)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(30, 100))
p <- p +
  labs(tag = "(c)") +
  theme(
    plot.tag          = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    plot.tag.position = c(0.008, 0.98)   # x, y in npc units: top-left
  )

print(p)

# Optional: Print summary statistics for each group
cat("\n===== SUMMARY STATISTICS =====\n\n")

for (group in c("DLD", "TYP")) {
  idx <- dat_plot$Group == group
  phon <- dat_plot$Phonology[idx]
  ctopp <- dat_plot$CTOPP[idx]
  
  cat(group, "Group:\n")
  cat("  Phonology - Mean:", round(mean(phon, na.rm = TRUE), 2), 
      ", SD:", round(sd(phon, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "\n")
  cat("  CTOPP    - Mean:", round(mean(ctopp, na.rm = TRUE), 2), 
      ", SD:", round(sd(ctopp, na.rm = TRUE), 2), "\n")
  cat("  N:", sum(!is.na(phon) & !is.na(ctopp)), "\n\n")
}
# ============================================================
# LINEAR REGRESSION MODELS & B-VALUES WITH CI
# ============================================================
cat("\n===== LINEAR REGRESSION RESULTS =====\n\n")

for (group in c("DLD", "TYP")) {
  idx <- dat_plot$Group == group
  
  # Fit model
  model <- lm(CTOPP ~ Phonology, data = dat_plot[idx, ])
  
  # Extract summary
  summary_stats <- summary(model)
  
  # Extract b-value and CI
  b_value <- coef(model)["Phonology"]
  ci <- confint(model, level = 0.95)["Phonology", ]
  p_value <- summary_stats$coefficients["Phonology", "Pr(>|t|)"]
  r_squared <- summary_stats$r.squared
  
  cat(group, "Group:\n")
  cat("  b-value:", round(b_value, 4), "\n")
  cat("  95% CI: [", round(ci[1], 4), ", ", round(ci[2], 4), "]\n")
  cat("  p-value:", round(p_value, 4), "\n")
  cat("  R²:", round(r_squared, 4), "\n")
  cat("  N:", sum(!is.na(dat_plot$Phonology[idx]) & !is.na(dat_plot$CTOPP[idx])), "\n\n")
}


# ============================================================
# BOXPLOTS: Elision (CTOPP-2) & Sound Task Accuracy by Group
# ============================================================

group_cols <- c("DLD" = "#66c2a5", "TYP" = "#fc8d62")

# Shared theme so boxplots match the scatter plot styling
theme_box <- theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title    = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x   = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y   = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, color = "black"),
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.border  = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, size = 0.7)
  )

# ---- Boxplot 1: Elision (CTOPP-2) ----
p_box_ctopp <- ggplot(dat_plot, aes(x = Group, y = CTOPP, fill = Group)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.55, alpha = 0.7, color = "black",
               outlier.shape = NA, linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.12, size = 3, shape = 21, alpha = 0.8,
              color = "black", stroke = 0.4) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 23, size = 3.5,
               fill = "white", color = "black") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Elision (CTOPP-2)") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_cols) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 20)) +
  theme_box

# ---- Boxplot 2: Sound Task Accuracy ----
p_box_phon <- ggplot(dat_plot, aes(x = Group, y = Phonology, fill = Group)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.55, alpha = 0.7, color = "black",
               outlier.shape = NA, linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.12, size = 3, shape = 21, alpha = 0.8,
              color = "black", stroke = 0.4) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 23, size = 3.5,
               fill = "white", color = "black") +
  labs( x = NULL, y = "Sound Task Accuracy (%)") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_cols) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(30, 100)) +
  theme_box

print(p_box_ctopp)
print(p_box_phon)

# ---- Side-by-side panel (needs patchwork; falls back gracefully) ----
if (requireNamespace("patchwork", quietly = TRUE)) {
  library(patchwork)
 p_boxes <- (p_box_ctopp | p_box_phon) 



# ---- Group comparisons (Welch t-test + Wilcoxon) ----
cat("\n===== GROUP COMPARISONS =====\n\n")

for (v in c("Phonology", "CTOPP")) {
  lab <- ifelse(v == "Phonology", "Sound Task Accuracy (%)", "Elision (CTOPP-2)")
  f   <- as.formula(paste(v, "~ Group"))
  tt  <- t.test(f, data = dat_plot)
  wt  <- suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(f, data = dat_plot))
  
  cat(lab, "\n")
  cat("  Welch t-test: t =", round(tt$statistic, 3),
      ", df =", round(tt$parameter, 2),
      ", p =", round(tt$p.value, 4), "\n")
  cat("  Mean diff (DLD - TYP):", round(diff(rev(tt$estimate)), 3),
      " 95% CI [", round(tt$conf.int[1], 3), ", ",
      round(tt$conf.int[2], 3), "]\n", sep = "")
  cat("  Wilcoxon: W =", wt$statistic, ", p =", round(wt$p.value, 4), "\n\n")
}

# Create combined plot with larger spacing
combined_plot <- (p_boxes / p ) + 
  plot_layout(guides = "collect", heights = c(1, 1))+
    patchwork::plot_annotation(
      tag_levels = "a",
      tag_prefix = "(",
      tag_suffix = ")"
    ) &
    theme(plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14))
  print(p_boxes)
}

# Display with larger size
combined_plot

# SAVE as high-resolution PNG (recommended)
ggsave("Elision_sound_task_accuracy.png", plot = combined_plot, width = 6, height = 6, dpi = 300)

```

# Define all 4 variables
vars <- list(
  Sem_Task_Accuracy_DLD = dat_sem$Sem_Task_Accuracy_DLD,
  CELF_WC_ScS_DLD     = dat_sem$`CELF_WC_ScS_DLD`,
  Sem_Task_Accuracy_TYP = dat_sem$Sem_Task_Accuracy_TYP,

)

cat("===== SHAPIRO-WILK NORMALITY TEST =====\n\n")

normality_results <- data.frame()

for (var_name in names(vars)) {
  # Convert to numeric if not already
  variable_data <- as.numeric(vars[[var_name]])
  # Remove NA values
  variable_data <- variable_data[!is.na(variable_data)]

  normality_results <- rbind(normality_results, data.frame(

    W_statistic = round(test$statistic, 4),
    p_value     = round(test$p.value, 4),

}

}
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

cat("\nInterpretation: p-value > 0.05 = Normal | p-value < 0.05 = Not Normal\n")

# ---- Decision Logic: Pearson vs Spearman ----

celf_dld_normal <- normality_results$p_value[normality_results$Variable == "CELF_WC_ScS_DLD"] > 0.05

celf_typ_normal <- normality_results$p_value[normality_results$Variable == "CELF_WC_ScS_TYP"] > 0.05

# Determine appropriate test for each pair

}

  p_value <- summary_stats$coefficients["Semantics", "Pr(>|t|)"]
  r_squared <- summary_stats$r.squared
  
  cat(group, "Group:\n")

    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    axis.title       = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, color = "black"),
    axis.title.x     = element_blank(),
    legend.position  = "none",
    panel.border     = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, size = 0.7),
    plot.margin      = margin(4, 6, 4, 6)
  )

# ---- Boxplot 1: Word Classes (CELF) ----
p_box_celf <- ggplot(dat_plot, aes(x = Group, y = CELF, fill = Group)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.55, alpha = 0.7, color = "black",
               outlier.shape = NA, linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.12, size = 3, shape = 21, alpha = 0.8,
              color = "black", stroke = 0.4) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 23, size = 3.5,
               fill = "white", color = "black") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Word Classes (CELF-5)") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_cols) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 20)) +
  theme_box

# ---- Boxplot 2: Meaning Task Accuracy ----
p_box_sem <- ggplot(dat_plot, aes(x = Group, y = Semantics, fill = Group)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.55, alpha = 0.7, color = "black",
               outlier.shape = NA, linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.12, size = 3, shape = 21, alpha = 0.8,
              color = "black", stroke = 0.4) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 23, size = 3.5,
               fill = "white", color = "black") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Meaning Task Accuracy (%)") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = group_cols) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(30, 101)) +
  theme_box

print(p_box_celf)
print(p_box_sem)


# ---- Side-by-side panel (needs patchwork; falls back gracefully) ----
if (requireNamespace("patchwork", quietly = TRUE)) {
  library(patchwork)
 p_boxes <- (p_box_celf | p_box_sem)

# ---- Group comparisons (Welch t-test + Wilcoxon) ----
cat("\n===== GROUP COMPARISONS =====\n\n")

for (v in c("CELF", "Semantics")) {
  lab <- ifelse(v == "CELF", "Word Classes (CELF-5)", "Meaning Task Accuracy (%)")
  f   <- as.formula(paste(v, "~ Group"))
  tt  <- t.test(f, data = dat_plot)
  wt  <- suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(f, data = dat_plot))
  
  cat(lab, "\n")
  cat("  Welch t-test: t =", round(tt$statistic, 3),
      ", df =", round(tt$parameter, 2),
      ", p =", round(tt$p.value, 4), "\n")
  cat("  Mean diff (DLD - TYP): ", round(diff(rev(tt$estimate)), 3),
      " 95% CI [", round(tt$conf.int[1], 3), ", ",
      round(tt$conf.int[2], 3), "]\n", sep = "")
  cat("  Wilcoxon: W =", wt$statistic, ", p =", round(wt$p.value, 4), "\n\n")
}
# Create combined plot with larger spacing
combined_plot <- (p_boxes / p ) + 
  plot_layout(guides = "collect", heights = c(1, 1)) +
    patchwork::plot_annotation(
      tag_levels = "a",
      tag_prefix = "(",
      tag_suffix = ")"
    ) &
    theme(plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16))
  print(p_boxes)
}

# Display with larger size
combined_plot

# SAVE as high-resolution PNG (recommended)
ggsave("WC_meaning_task_accuracy.png", plot = combined_plot, width = 6, height = 6, dpi = 300)
